title: forge cannot be left unset, so a project with no forge gets unknown:forge from stalled (second-project run)
goal: backlog.json accepts an empty forge, meaning the project has no forge: stalled, land and red-pipeline skip the merge request and pipeline reads and say so, with no unknown:forge signal

run: import os,subprocess,sys,tempfile; d=tempfile.mkdtemp(); subprocess.run(['git','init','-q',d]); open(os.path.join(d,'backlog.json'),'w').write('{"forge": ""}'); r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/backlog.py','--root',d,'config'],capture_output=True,text=True); sys.exit(1 if r.returncode==2 else 0)

import pathlib,subprocess,sys,tempfile; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import backlog, bl_stall; from bl_base import load_settings; host=tempfile.mkdtemp(); subprocess.run(['git','init','-q',host],check=True); pathlib.Path(host,'backlog.json').write_text('{"forge": ""}', encoding='utf-8'); load_settings(host); bl=backlog.Backlog(host); bl.items['TK-aaaaaaaa']={'id':'TK-aaaaaaaa','kind':'task','status':'doing','claimed_by':'x'}; c=bl_stall.collect(bl, run=lambda argv, cwd=None: (1,'','')); print(c['items']); sys.exit(1 if any('unknown:forge' in i['unknown'] for i in c['items']) else 0)
